items.title: Authorizing the Director of Transportation to execute Contract No. SFMTA-2024-78 with ICF Jones & Stokes, Inc., and Contract No. SFMTA-2024-79 with Environmental Science Associates for as-needed environmental analysis services and public outreach and engagement primarily for the Building Progress Program. Each contract has an initial term of six years, with two options to extend the term for an additional year, for a total of eight years, and a not-to-exceed amount of $4,500,000 over the eight-year period.
